data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 296.0m in 2020, representing 37.06% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by large losses and attritional deterioration in short-tail lines such as Marine, Onshore Energy, Hull, Marine Liability, and Property, as well as the impact of natural catastrophe events including an unusually active North Atlantic Hurricane season. Additionally, COVID-19 related event cancellation losses from the 2019 year of account contributed to the strengthening.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted by the Reinsurance To Close of the 2017 and prior years of account into Syndicate 3500, and the 2018 year of account into the 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1200, making it unreliable for direct prior year development calculation. The 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' from the Claims Outstanding reconciliation (page 27) is used as the primary source for prior year development.
